businessDomains.name: Takaful
businessDomains.note: Takaful is MUTUAL RISK-SHARING from a participants' fund, not insurance underwriting. The operator manages the fund for a wakala fee and/or a mudarabah share of investment profit; it does not own the risk. Claims are paid from the participants' risk fund; surplus returns to participants; a deficit is covered by an interest-free qard from the shareholders' fund, repayable at par. Getting the fund accounting right IS the domain — see AAOIFI Financial Accounting for where it becomes a number.

SS 38 §8/2/2 accepts an electronic signature 'where recognised by prevailing rules' — a jurisdiction test I modelled as an optional eSignatureRef with no validity assertion, because validity is a legal question the catalog cannot answer.

ISB-BDC-09 is a weak assert: it only catches the crudest misuse (interactionId stored in the identity field). Genuinely proving an interaction id is never trusted as identity is a code-review and middleware property, not a row-level rule. Stated plainly rather than dressed up.

Branch sessions have a staff-actor dimension (who served whom, dual control, on-behalf-of actions) that I modelled only as authentication.staffActorRef. A real branch operations model needs more and I did not invent it.
I did not model accessibility, language or disclosure-readability requirements, which IFSB-30 ¶274-275's 'standardisation of terms and language' arguably reaches.

areaWideGaps: DESIGN.md §7's ContractType enum (10 values) cannot name four of this area's own products: Takaful, Retakaful, Ujrah and Tawarruq, and has no member for an infrastructure domain with no nominate contract. Raised per §7 rather than silently diverged from. Two of this fragment's entries (IFSB Regulatory Reporting, Branch And Digital Channel Operation) DO extend the enum, because a per-contract-type regulatory breakdown and an honest product label are impossible without it — those two divergences are declared in their uncertain[] blocks and need the design owner's decision.

The AAOIFI Financial Accounting Standards governing TAKAFUL fund accounting were never obtained by this estate's research. IFSB-27/28/29 are verified by number, title and date only, with no clause text. The participants-fund / shareholders-fund ring-fence — the most important thing in this business area — therefore rests on industry practice, not on a clause anyone here can cite. It must be confirmed clause-by-clause before any takaful rule is called compliant.

AAOIFI SS 21's 30/30/5 screening thresholds could not be verified against primary text, and sources disagree on the purification formula. No threshold is in this fragment: screening criteria are carried from a versioned, SSB-approved criteria set. A generator default here would be manufacturing authority.

PER/IRR is a JURISDICTIONAL FORK, not a feature: AAOIFI SS 46 §6/6 and IFSB GN-3 permit smoothing while BNM PD 028-63 ¶13.5 forbids it. Every rule touching PER/IRR must be emitted behind a jurisdiction flag. Hard-coding either position makes the product unshippable in half the market.
No 'Islamic Open Banking' standard exists, and this estate's research found no IFSB technology or open-banking standard and no IFSB-32 as of Nov 2026. Nothing in this area may claim one.

Behaviour-qualifier names here follow BIAN's generic behaviour-qualifier style, but NO official BIAN Service Landscape release is on disk in this estate (the conventional catalog self-describes as 'BIAN-inspired'), so they are NOT verified against published BIAN BQ names for these service domains. They are correct as sub-resource decompositions and unverified as BIAN nomenclature.
Multi-tenancy: there is no tenant_id anywhere in this estate (DESIGN.md §5.3). No entry here invents one; the seam stays in the shared module as §5.3 specifies.

Four of these twelve domains (Payment Order, Payment Execution, KYC And Shariah Screening, Financial Crime Monitoring) duplicate GRADUATED BIAN services in bian-services (sd-payment-order, sd-payment-execution, sd-know-your-customer, sd-fraud-detection). I deliberately reused their status vocabularies, their *Minor money convention and their sub-resource style. Whether the Islamic estate should own second copies or consume the conventional ones behind a Shariah gate is an owner decision I did not make.
